Write music in LilyPond and engrave it here, with no server: LilyPond itself runs on the device. The PDF is saved beside the score.

Everything stays on this device. The app has no internet access, so nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is collected about you. It reads and writes only the folder you choose, and keeps a working copy of its LilyPond files inside the app while it compiles. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Pressing the donation or website line opens your browser.

This app is made by wander wildwood, an independent developer: one person, not a company. That makes wander wildwood the data controller for anything the app itself handles, and that is very little: what you put in stays on this device unless you send it somewhere yourself, and nothing comes to the developer.
Write to email@wanderthe.dev, about your data or anything else.

Under the GDPR you can ask to see the data held about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to limit or object to its use, to take a copy with you, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a data protection authority. Since the app keeps nothing but the files in the folder you chose and a working copy inside the app, you can do most of this yourself: clear the app\'s data in Android\'s settings, or uninstall the app.
